message: The other day, I decided to check our go-bags, and as I pulled everything out, my grandkids came over to help. Instead of it feeling like a chore, we turned it into a little adventure! We made it a game to see who could pack the most essential items while sharing stories about what we’d do in different situations. 😊 It reminded me that preparedness doesn’t have to be daunting; it can be a cozy family moment filled with laughter and learning. Have you turned a task into a fun family experience lately?
